nodes.name: windowproxy.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the WindowProxy DOM struct managing browsing context relationships, frame/element references, cross-origin proxy handlers, and window.open() with feature tokenization.

nodes.name: WindowProxy
nodes.summary: DOM struct for the WindowProxy, managing browsing context identity, frame relationships, opener tracking, and cross-origin proxy handlers for secure cross-window access.

nodes.name: CreatorBrowsingContextInfo

nodes.name: WindowProxyHandler
nodes.summary: Proxy handler (from js::glue) that routes window property access to either the standard proxy handler or the cross-origin restricted handler based on origin.
